skill.pz_moodle_immersion.aiming.desc: Improves accuracy and damage with bows, crossbows and ranged weapons.
skill.pz_moodle_immersion.reloading.desc: Improves loading, unloading and magazine changes.
skill.pz_moodle_immersion.axe.desc: Improves axe weapon attacks and chopping efficiency.
skill.pz_moodle_immersion.long_blade.des: Improves long-blade attack speed, damage and critical chance.
skill.pz_moodle_immersion.long_blunt.des: Improves long-blunt attack speed, damage and critical chance.
skill.pz_moodle_immersion.maintenance.de: Reduces the chance of losing melee weapon durability on hit.
skill.pz_moodle_immersion.short_blade.de: Improves short-blade attack speed, damage and critical chance.
skill.pz_moodle_immersion.short_blunt.de: Improves short-blunt attack speed, damage and critical chance.
skill.pz_moodle_immersion.spear.desc: Improves spear attack speed, damage and critical chance.
Improves forging metal tools, weapons and parts.
skill.pz_moodle_immersion.carpentry.desc: Improves wooden structures, furniture and woodwork.
skill.pz_moodle_immersion.carving.desc: Improves making wood, bone and simple tools with a knife.
skill.pz_moodle_immersion.cooking.desc: Improves food preparation, nutrition and food safety.
skill.pz_moodle_immersion.electrical.des: Improves dismantling and building electrical devices.
skill.pz_moodle_immersion.glassmaking.de: Improves melting sand, broken glass and making glass items.
skill.pz_moodle_immersion.knapping.desc: Improves making flint and other stone tools.
skill.pz_moodle_immersion.mechanics.desc: Improves vehicle and mechanical device work.
skill.pz_moodle_immersion.pottery.desc: Improves clay, brick and pottery work.
skill.pz_moodle_immersion.tailoring.desc: Improves ripping, patching and making clothing.
skill.pz_moodle_immersion.welding.desc: Improves welding metal structures, tools and items.
skill.pz_moodle_immersion.agriculture.de: Improves planting, checking and caring for crops.
skill.pz_moodle_immersion.animal_care.de: Improves checking animals and harvesting animal resources.
skill.pz_moodle_immersion.butchering.des: Improves processing animals and meat quality.
skill.pz_moodle_immersion.fitness.desc: Affects endurance, attack speed, exercise and fall damage.
skill.pz_moodle_immersion.lightfooted.de: Improves quiet movement and sneaking speed.
skill.pz_moodle_immersion.nimble.desc: Improves attack speed and movement agility.
skill.pz_moodle_immersion.sprinting.desc: Improves running speed, sprint endurance and movement efficiency.
skill.pz_moodle_immersion.sneaking.desc: Improves hiding your movement and approaching targets.
skill.pz_moodle_immersion.strength.desc: Affects melee damage, encumbrance, knockback and forcing obstacles.
skill.pz_moodle_immersion.first_aid.desc: Improves judging injuries and the speed and effect of treatment.
skill.pz_moodle_immersion.fishing.desc: Improves catch chance, line stability and fish quality.
skill.pz_moodle_immersion.foraging.desc: Improves search radius, detection speed and find chance.
skill.pz_moodle_immersion.tracking.desc: Improves identifying and locating animal tracks.
skill.pz_moodle_immersion.trapping.desc: Improves making traps and catching animals.
occupation.pz_moodle_immersion.firefight: They don't fight fires. They save the living.
occupation.pz_moodle_immersion.police.bo: The last procedure is pressed into the magazine.
occupation.pz_moodle_immersion.carpenter: The nails remain. The house is gone.
occupation.pz_moodle_immersion.farmer.bo: Turning rotten flesh into the soil, waiting for a spring that will never come.
occupation.pz_moodle_immersion.doctor.bo: One cut, one life. A fine line.
A master craftsman, a grade-8 fitter.
occupation.pz_moodle_immersion.hobo.bonu: Finally no one drives him away.
occupation.pz_moodle_immersion.rancher.b: A gust of wind leaves only the herd and the cattle.
occupation.pz_moodle_immersion.brewer.bo: One stiff drink, and the apocalypse goes down easier.
occupation.pz_moodle_immersion.fishing_g: Once served in the air force.
occupation.pz_moodle_immersion.maintenan: Patching things together, fixing the old and worn.
occupation.pz_moodle_immersion.burglar.b: Over walls and gone without a trace.
occupation.pz_moodle_immersion.security_: I'm the guard, and I love teddy-bear cookies.
occupation.pz_moodle_immersion.park_rang: Blazing trails, living off the land.
occupation.pz_moodle_immersion.prepper.b: Mindset and willpower always come before skills and gear.
occupation.pz_moodle_immersion.village_h: The whole village remembers what you did. You carry Hero of the Village permanently: cheaper trades, golems leave you alone, zombies notice you sooner. Comes with the exclusive trait Beloved.
trait.pz_moodle_immersion.outdoorsman.de: Foraging +1 (apple leaf chance +1%/lvl, berries +20%/lvl), Tracking +1, Trapping +1.
trait.pz_moodle_immersion.cats_eye.desc: Automatic hidden Night Vision in the dark (light <= 3).
trait.pz_moodle_immersion.graceful.desc: Lightfooted +1, Nimble +1, Sneaking +1; sprint & melee stamina cost -15%.
trait.pz_moodle_immersion.organized.desc: Pickup range +30%; nearby drops are pulled toward you.
trait.pz_moodle_immersion.keen_hearing.d: No extra effect in the current version; costs 6 trait points.
trait.pz_moodle_immersion.athletic.desc: Strength +1 (attack +10%), Fitness +2 (health +40%), Sprinting +1 (speed +5%); stamina cap scales with fitness.
trait.pz_moodle_immersion.strong.desc: Strength +2 (attack +20%, mining +4%/pt); encumbrance starts at 8 + 2xStrength; Strength 10 = no encumbrance.
Sneaking +1: mobs notice you 5% closer per level (up to -50%).
trait.pz_moodle_immersion.iron_gut.desc: 80% chance to be immune to poison.
trait.pz_moodle_immersion.resilient.desc: Fitness +1 (health +20%); First Aid +1 (healing +5%/lvl, use time -5%/lvl, cooldown -5%/lvl).
trait.pz_moodle_immersion.smoker.desc: +10 stress per day without a smoke; quits automatically after 30 in-game days.
trait.pz_moodle_immersion.drunkard.desc: +15 stress per day without a drink; quits automatically after 60 in-game days.
trait.pz_moodle_immersion.clumsy.desc: Nimble -1 (attack speed -5%); Sneaking -1, Cooking -1; sprint & melee stamina cost +15%.
trait.pz_moodle_immersion.slow_healer.de: Fitness -1 (health -20%); no extra healing penalty in the current version.
trait.pz_moodle_immersion.weak_stomach.d: No extra effect in the current version; refunds 3 points.
trait.pz_moodle_immersion.conspicuous.de: Sneaking -1: easier for mobs to notice you.
trait.pz_moodle_immersion.sleepyhead.des: Fatigue builds x1.5 (20 -> 30 per day); Sprinting -1.
trait.pz_moodle_immersion.pacifist.desc: Your attack damage x0.7 (-30%); refunds 4 points.
trait.pz_moodle_immersion.hearty_appetit: No extra effect in the current version; refunds 4 points.
trait.pz_moodle_immersion.asthmatic.desc: Fitness -1 (health -20%), Sprinting -1 (speed -5%); lower stamina cap, slows down sooner.
trait.pz_moodle_immersion.hemophobia.des: No extra effect in the current version; refunds 5 points.
trait.pz_moodle_immersion.disorganized.d: No extra effect (mutually exclusive with Organized); refunds 4 points.
trait.pz_moodle_immersion.high_thirst.de: No extra effect in the current version; refunds 6 points.
trait.pz_moodle_immersion.axeman.desc: All axes chop wood at golden-axe speed, then x1.25 faster; axe attack cooldown -25%; Axe +2, Maintenance +1.
trait.pz_moodle_immersion.patient.desc: First Aid +1 (healing +5%/lvl, use time -5%/lvl, cooldown -5%/lvl); Maintenance +1.
trait.pz_moodle_immersion.short_temper.d: Maintenance -1; no other effect in the current version.
trait.pz_moodle_immersion.marksman.desc: Aiming +1 plus Aiming skill +1 (ranged damage about +10%, cap +50%); Reloading +1 (reload speed +5%/lvl).
trait.pz_moodle_immersion.night_owl.desc: Night move speed +10% and hidden Night Vision at night; Sneaking +1.
trait.pz_moodle_immersion.bloody_fury.de: After taking damage, attack x1.5 for 5 seconds; repeated hits extend duration but never stack.
trait.pz_moodle_immersion.beloved.desc: Takes no damage from other players: melee, arrows, splash potions and gunfire all bounce off. Mobs and the environment still hurt normally.
trait.pz_moodle_immersion.fearless.desc: Panic builds x0.2 (-80%). Awarded at 10000 zombie kills.
trait.pz_moodle_immersion.numb.desc: Stress and panic are constantly cleared to zero. Awarded at 100000 zombie kills; Veteran and Prepper start with it.
